task.title: Determining if a postdate is required

step.cmd: Determine if the recovery week is indefinite based on a medical certificate that indicates terminal or palliative:
Determine if the BPC has been postdated due to earnings in week 1.

ul.li: If yes, the BPC is the last week worked unless the client specifically requested to postdate the claim. Go to step 15.

step.cmd: Determine if postdating the BPC is advantageous to the client or if the client is entitled to a requested postdate:

ul.li: If no, go to Determining if an automatic antedate is required . Determining if an automatic antedate is required

step.cmd: Determine if a postdate will result in a BPC that falls after the calendar week of the application:
Determine if the BPC is postdated for one of the following reasons:

ul.li: The BT is maternity and parental and the BP is postdated to pay full benefits.

The week of filing was a full work week.
If no, go to step 6.
If yes, go to step 15.

step.cmd: Determine if the BPC is postdated to fall within the benefit window for maternity or parental benefits:
On the calculation worksheet, note that the N-00-00-00 letter is required. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Antedate Denied or Postdate Message-Initial/Renewal/Continuing claim (2481)

Postdate - Initial Claim (2487)
TEXT: Reason(s) why claim was postdated
Text - Insert appropriate post-date reason (1068): Type “you do not meet the entitlement requirements for [special benefits type] until [BPC date].”

step.cmd: Determine if the BPC is postdated by more than one week:
On the calculation worksheet, note that the N-00-00-00 letter may be required. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Antedate Denied or Postdate Message - Initial/Renewal/Continuing claim (2481)

step.cmd: Determine if fact-finding has already occurred with the client to obtain information on additional insurable hours or earnings accumulated after the EI application was filed:

ul.li: If no, fact-find with the client. If the client has worked after the application date and before the date the BPC could be postdated to, the postdate cannot be granted. Advise the client that he or she may qualify if a new application is filed. fact-find

step.cmd: Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client was contacted, go to step 12.
If the client was not contacted, the postdate cannot be granted. Go to step 14.

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Confirmation of last day worked or paid.”
Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Determine if the client has accumulated any other insurable hours or earnings after the EI application was submitted and before the date the BPC could be postdated to:

ul.li: If yes, the postdate cannot be granted. Go to step 14.

step.cmd: On the calculation worksheet, note that if the client is BPNE N6 with a BPC before July 3, 2016, you must override the automated BPNE letter and manually create one. Also note that when this occurs, in FTS, from the File Control Data (M101) transaction, you must select Claim Action — Automated Letter Bypass to prevent the creation of the automated BPNE letter and manually create one with the following details:

ul.li:
This letter replaces or Footnote (2365) :
Footnote: Once we receive your application, we will determine eligibility and establish a new claim if you now qualify for benefits.
Go to Determining if an automatic antedate is required . Determining if an automatic antedate is required

step.cmd: In SSO, on the Coding Requirement s screen, enter the manual BPC as follows:

ul.li: Subsequent or manual BPC: Select the Sunday date of the manual BPC.

step.cmd: Determine if any changes were made in SSO:

ul.li: If no, go to Determining if the Administrative Policy applies . Determining if the Administrative Policy applies
If yes, go to step 9 of Calculating a claim in SSO . Calculating a claim in SSO
